<b>Spinebeak Kais</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are plump floaters with sharp beaks, long lost to time and living on only in memory. 

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Spinebeak Kais start off floating around idly; however, once they detect Hornet they pursue her relentlessly.<br>
Before attacking, it'll try to get horizontally aligned with Hornet, then performing a short dash attack towards her with its pointy beak once she's in range.

Spinebeak Kais deal {{Damage|1}} on all attacks and contact damage.

== [[Needolin]] Dialogue ==
{{SS Needolin|columns=2|
* The crust covers...
* The crust conceals...
* Our shells made strong...
* Our nest made secret...
}}

== Location ==
Spinebeak Kais can only be found in [[Crust King Khann]]'s [[Elegy of the Deep|Memory]] of the [[Coral Tower]] during [[Acts|Act 3]].
